user.title: Voice Broadcast
user.description: Say "broadcast <message>" to Assist and hear your own voice on the speakers you choose. Only the devices you list in the two target lists receive broadcasts; an empty list means none of that kind. All other voice commands pass through unchanged.

data.output_dir: Recording folder (relative to the config directory, or absolute)
data.auto_broadcast: Broadcast automatically when a recording is made
data.agent: Assistant for normal commands (everything that is not a broadcast)
data.confirm: Confirmation spoken on the source satellite (empty = silent)
data.targets: Media player targets (empty = no media players)
data.preannounce: Play the satellite chime before the announcement

error.upstream_not_found: The selected speech-to-text entity does not exist or is not set up.
